subject: Endpoint tooling license transition playbook
messages:
From: Anne Lewis <anne.lewis@securewatch.io>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vendor Procurement <procurement@securewatch.io>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Endpoint tooling license transition playbook

Hi all,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our call I attached a concise transition playbook and an updated quote (v3) — files attached. High level: SecureWatch will support a phased migration from your current MDM and EDR fleet to our combined agent, scoped to 1,200 endpoints across US engineering and product teams.

Key asks from us to start:
- Signed SOW or PO for the pilot (30 days, up to 150 endpoints)
- Confirmation of invoice recipient and PO coding (you mentioned splitting between Engineering and Security)
- Contact for technical onboarding (we'll need a point-of-contact for jumpstarts + VPN access to staging)

We included a short checklist (license-transition-checklist.xlsx) that maps responsibilities and a suggested schedule for the 8-week phased rollout. If that looks good we can circulate a DocuSign link for the SOW and lock dates.

Attachments: SecureWatch-quote-v3.pdf, license-transition-checklist.xlsx

Best,
Anne Lewis
Account Executive, SecureWatch
anne.lewis@securewatch.io
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Endpoint tooling license transition playbook

Anne — thanks for the quick turnaround and the playbook. A few clarifications before I take this to procurement: 

1) Seat counts: the quote shows 1,200 total, with a 150-endpoint pilot. Can you confirm that the pilot seats are included in the total commitment rather than additive? We prefer pilot to be carved out of the contract.
2) Retention: we need to ensure EDR telemetry retention can be set per-region (US/EU). Are the default retention windows 90 days for hot storage and 2 years for cold?
3) Auto-updates and sensor management: will we be able to pin sensor versions during the pilot? We need to avoid an automatic forced update mid-rollout.
4) Invoicing: we want separate invoices for Engineering and Security. Please confirm you can split the bill and use two PO numbers.

Also looping Legal (Marissa) for SOW review; Marissa — can you flag any concerns early?

I'll run the checklist internally and propose a procurement kickoff on Monday 2026-07-27 if we get PO guidance by Friday. See attached: license-transition-checklist.xlsx (I've annotated a few rows).

Thanks,
Dev
Head of IT Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Anne Lewis <anne.lewis@securewatch.io>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vendor Procurement <procurement@securewatch.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 12:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Endpoint tooling license transition playbook

Thanks, Dev — good questions. Short answers below and I've updated the quote accordingly (v3):

1) Pilot seats: confirmed — the 150 pilot seats are carved out of the 1,200 total commitment. Pilot usage will count toward the committed total.
2) Retention: yes — we support region-specific retention. Default hot storage is 90 days, cold is 24 months; EU customers get a configurable option to keep only EU data in-region (we'll include the configuration in the SOW).
3) Sensor pinning: supported for pilot and rollout phases. We'll provide a management policy in the onboarding playbook; forced updates require a separate change request.
4) Invoicing split: procurement@securewatch.io confirmed they can issue two invoices and accept two PO numbers; they'll need the PO line items to match the quote breakdown.

We can run a 30-day trial starting the week of 2026-08-03. DocuSign SOW link: https://securewatch.docusign.com/s/SW-SOW-2026-07 (expires 2026-08-10).

If you want, we can also schedule a short technical kickoff with our onboarding engineer (cc'ed) to walk through network requirements next Tuesday 2026-07-28.

Best,
Anne

Team — forwarding the vendor confirmation and updated quote. Summary / next steps I want us to own before the procurement kickoff Monday 07/27: 

- Laura: please validate departmental PO codes and confirm who signs off on invoices for Engineering. We need two POs: ENG-PO-2026-045 (Engineering) and SEC-PO-2026-046 (Security).
- Markus: validate network and EDR sensor pinning with infra (check that we can host the management console in our VPC and request any firewall rules). Schedule the 30-min technical kickoff with SecureWatch for 07/28 if feasible.
- Marissa: quick SOW read — flag any unusual indemnity or data residency clauses (I highlighted sections 3 and 6 in the checklist).

I will draft the internal approval email for procurement and attach the quote + checklist. Once procurement confirms PO splits we'll sign the DocuSign SOW and kick off the pilot.
